[size=6]Introduce[/size]
[size=3]
The mod can help you do many things.You can simply edit the config.json file and set the functions you want to use to true. Or download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] mod and use the in-game config menu to enable the functions more easily.Here are the specific features of the mod.[/size]
